summary: A sports/gaming app with leaderboard, profiles, badges, chat, calendar, and admin features. Currently building out a major multi-feature update in two parts: (1) profile badge progress, clickable leaderboard modals, games played column, paginated match history; (2) expanded chat emoji reactions and admin analytics dashboard + manual badge management.
architectural_notes: Large multi-feature updates are split into two builds: (1) profile/leaderboard/match history, (2) chat emoji + admin analytics/badges
Leaderboard player profiles use a modal overlay (not dedicated page) as first implementation; can switch later
known_issues: Large combined builds are failing; workaround is to split into smaller sequential builds

existing_features.title: In the Profile tab, display all available badge definitions (not just earned ones). For each unearned badge, show a progress bar and a count label (e.g., '3/10 wins') indicating the user's current progress toward earning it. Earned badges should remain visually distinct (e.g., full color) while unearned badges appear dimmed with the progress indicator overlaid.

Make player rows in the Leaderboard tab clickable. Clicking a player opens a modal overlay showing that player's profile: a bar chart of wins/losses over time, current and best win streaks, and their earned badges.
Add a 'Games Played' column to the Leaderboard tab table, showing each player's total number of games (wins + losses).
Replace the current 5-entry match history limit in the Profile tab with a fully paginated match history list. Users should be able to page through all of their historical match records.

new_feature_requests.summary: Profile tab: show all available badges with progress bars and counts for unearned badges
Leaderboard tab: clickable players open a modal with bar chart, streaks, and earned badges
Leaderboard tab: add Games Played column
Full paginated match history beyond last 5 entries
Chat: expanded fixed emoji reactions set (👍 👎 😂 ❤️ 🔥 😮)
Admin tab: analytics dashboard (total games, most active players, busiest calendar days)
Admin tab: manually award or revoke badges from users
